name: OpenMetadata
description: Centralises data catalog, lineage, and quality metadata so agents can discover which tables exist, where they came from, and whether they can be trusted.

skills.name: Asset Discovery
skills.description: Searches tables, dashboards, and pipelines across connected sources with ownership and tags.

skills.name: Lineage Trace
skills.description: Traces column-level lineage upstream and downstream to assess the blast radius of a change.

skills.name: Quality Status
skills.description: Reports data-quality test results and freshness so agents can judge whether an asset is reliable.
